title: The  Retreat: Location, Space and Convenience
description:
Spacious 3 bedroom retreat with two full baths that sleeps 6, has free parking and is minutes from all Nashville has to offer. Comes with a complete security system. 
*Note: Not needed but understandably helps make some feel more safe.

Note - This is the first floor of a two story duplex.
*No Smoking.

***The space is not intended to host house parties. When we discover you are hosting a house party you will be asked to leave the property immediately******

The space
Note - This is the first floor of a two story duplex. 
*******The upstairs balcony goes with the upstairs unit.**********

We have WiFi! 
Though much of your time will likely be spent enjoying all that Nashville has to offer, the home does come with a TV that has Netflix access. 

The home has a large open layout floor plan. 
The kitchen has cooking supplies and of course COFFEE! 
The master bedroom has a queen size bed and a connected full bathroom.
Bedrooms one and two are off the main hallway and comes with two twin beds. 

Each of the three bedrooms comes with a Multi USB wall charger for up to 4 devices.

***The space is not intended to host house parties. When we discover you are hosting a house party you will be asked to leave the property******

Guest access
The key code for access to the home will be provided 24 hours ahead of your scheduled booking date/time.
